caption: The drawing depicts a wooden ship’s figurehead mounted on a plain beige or off-white background. The figurehead consists of the upper torso and head of a female figure with her hair pulled back and a decorative element protruding from the top of her head. Her facial features and neck are clearly defined, with detailed carving showing her shoulders, chest, and the top of a draped, strapless garment. On her right side, she holds or is surrounded by an ornate, leafy scrollwork. The base of the figurehead is attached to a curved, dark brown wooden beam and a vertical wooden plank, which together create an L-shaped support structure. The wood appears to be a combination of medium to dark brown tones, and the texture and grain of the wood are visible throughout the carving and support pieces. The background is plain with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Figurehead
